md_log.template: Call the md_log tool with filepath "{{args}}". The file must already exist. Confirm linking and mention Obsidian rendering.
md_log.description: Mirror session to markdown file for Obsidian (like pi /md-log)

md_unlog.template: Call the md_unlog tool to stop mirroring.
md_unlog.description: Stop mirroring session to markdown file (like pi /md-unlog)
